svg.title: A001379 15-dimensional Hilbert trace on the 14-sphere
svg.desc: All fifteen prime-exponent dimensions are normalized onto S14, ordered by an 8-bit 15D Hilbert index, and orthogonally projected to rotating 3D. The lower panels retain the complete 194 by 194 irrep character table and all 221 supplied Moonshine prefixes. Exact compressed payloads are redundantly embedded in metadata for lossless recovery.
svg.text: one dimension per prime · 15D exponent cube → Hilbert order → unit 14-sphere → orthogonal 3D view
Each 15-vector is centered by its coordinate range and normalized to length 1, so it lies exactly on S¹⁴.
The visible globe is a 3D orthogonal projection, not the full sphere; colour follows Hilbert rank and hover exposes the exact vector.
Hilbert coordinates use 8 bits per dimension after independent range scaling · duplicate vectors receive adjacent stable ranks
46,137 supplied values · high-contrast visible atlas + redundant exact payload metadata · hover any cell for its exact value
